enchantment.mocurses.curseof_apnea.desc: Helmet. On land you slowly suffocate; under water you can breathe.
enchantment.mocurses.curseof_betrayal.de: Disabled in this modpack. Shield: sometimes fails to block a hit.
enchantment.mocurses.curseof_deteriorati: The cursed item slowly loses durability on its own while held or worn.
enchantment.mocurses.curseof_disorder.de: Chestplate. Items in your inventory periodically swap places.
enchantment.mocurses.curseof_flammabilit: Boots. Once on fire, you don't go out, and you set nearby creatures on fire.
enchantment.mocurses.curseof_floating.de: Chestplate. You float upwards and can't stay on the ground.
enchantment.mocurses.curseof_frost_impri: Helmet. Under water, the water above your head freezes, trapping you.
enchantment.mocurses.curseof_hordes.desc: Weapon. Hitting a monster may summon another one of the same kind. Doesn't work on animals.
enchantment.mocurses.curseof_movement.de: Boots. They wear out while you walk.
enchantment.mocurses.curseof_notice.desc: Chestplate. Hostile mobs notice you from much further away, neutral ones attack on sight.
enchantment.mocurses.curseof_station.des: Disabled in this modpack. Armor: standing still for a while gets you punished.
enchantment.mocurses.curseof_teleportati: Chestplate. Every now and then you get teleported a few blocks away.
enchantment.mocurses.curseof_the_golden_: Disabled in this modpack. A heavily used item turns into gold.
enchantment.mocurses.curseof_voiding.des: Disabled in this modpack. Destroys drops from blocks and mobs.
enchantment.mocurses.curseof_withering.d: Chestplate. Lowers your max health, withers nearby mobs and kills crops and flowers around you.
enchantment.mocurses.curseof_zone.desc: The item only works within a set area; carried beyond it, it gets dropped.
